name: dock-promo
description: Dock 30s product promo video (HTML/GSAP animation rendered frame-by-frame with Playwright + ffmpeg)

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -y -i out/video.mp4 -i out/audio.wav -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart dock-promo-30s.mp4
scripts.build: npm run meta && npm run video && npm run audio && npm run mux
scripts.mux:en: ffmpeg -y -i out/video-en.mp4 -i out/audio-en.wav -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart dock-promo-30s-en.mp4
scripts.build:en: npm run meta:en && npm run video:en && npm run audio:en && npm run mux:en
